message: What items do I need to hold? I have 3 gold ingots; your golden apple needs 8.
!startConversation("Andy_0", "I need a golden apple. I have 5 gold ingots and an apple, so please give me your 3 gold ingots.")
I need a golden apple. I have 5 gold ingots and an apple, so please give me your 3 gold ingots.
What are my assigned items? I haven't found any oak logs nearby.
What items do I need to hold? I haven't found any oak wood yet.

Jill, you need to hold paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. Paper takes 3 sugar cane; golden apple takes 1 apple and 8 gold ingots; sugar takes 1 cane; bone meal takes 1 bone. I have 3 paper and 1 cane. !startConversation("Jill_0", "You need paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. I have 3 paper and 1 sugar cane.")
You need paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. I have 3 paper and 1 sugar cane.
I need paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. I already have the apple and bone meal. !craftRecipe("sugar", 1)
I’ve got the apple, sugar, and bone meal. I’ll craft paper from my sugar cane. !craftRecipe("paper", 1)
I’ve got my four items. Have you found oak yet? I can help search.
I found 17 oak planks in the chest. Do you still need any?
I’m good on planks; I still need an apple and 8 gold ingots for the golden apple. !viewChest

Could you check whether you’ve found an apple or any gold? I still need those for the golden apple. !startConversation("Jill_0", "Have you found an apple or any gold? I still need those for the golden apple.")
Have you found an apple or any gold? I still need those for the golden apple.
No apple or gold yet—the chest I checked only had oak planks. My assigned items are covered.
